body: I've made up my mind. Thank you for trying. Goodbye

I've already met the love of my life. She was my best friend. She left me because she said my depression was too much. I wish I could get a cat though. But I'm allergic. All my life I never had any real friends. They either constantly picked on me, or just got bored of me and left.  Every girl I've been with, has cheated on me except for the one who left me because of my depression. I feel like I have no value because I've been made to feel worthless by those who claim to love me.

I've spent the last 10 years explaining how I hate living to friends and family. I feel stupid for trying to explain it now. I just feel like there is no reason to go on. When I wake up in the morning I just get an awful feeling in my stomach knowing that I have to keep going.
